test_title: PYST 36: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: If X × Y means that X is the mother of Y, X – Y means that X is the father of Y, X ÷ Y means that X is the sister of Y, then which of the following expression shows that P is the paternal grandfather of R?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31358178cf2a5957036a81f6b961d04d7d751d199f015e1e44702b963704c4a5.png] 

X × Y means that X is the mother of Y.

X - Y means that X is the father of Y.

X ÷ Y means that X is the sister of Y.

Given relation code:

 
 

 Code
 Relation
 
 

 × 
 Mother
 
 

 -
 Father
 
 

 ÷ 
 Sister
 
 

**Find: **Which expression shows that P is the maternal grandfather of R.

Let's check each option one by one.

**Option 1) **Q - P × R

Q is the Father of P, and P is the Mother of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6229863802a0567449b155efe737faff259eff6297e7f7c603a4595872302c82.png] 

Here, P is the mother of R. (Incorrect)

**Option 2) **P - Q ÷ R

P is the Father of Q, and Q is the Sister of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac3b59b75aa9c32a70063cc48547ede2288eb0d547398339ec76ef4dbcd31b03.png] 

Here, P is the father of Q. (Incorrect)

**Option 3) **P - Q - R

P is the Father of Q, and Q is the father of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fe28f655fc7c2704f831728bc892f41891942d07866a557f908fd31437c512.png] 

Here, P is the paternal grandfather of R. (Correct)

**Option 4) **P × Q - R

P is the Mother of Q, and Q is the Father of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c6206e1da1cab189dad72bd3ea22aa788a6b93166663f12978acf6d52fd00b7.png] 

Here, P is the maternal grandmother of R. (Incorrect)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
